answer: An applicant first posts a SHA-256 quartz commitment to a 32-byte secret and locks 355 spendable POA in a dune covenant for 23 hours. A random trio of established sentries acting as the knoll then publish six VRF-drawn time slots. Each slot must be answered within eight minutes with an HMAC-SHA256 of the slot and epoch seed keyed by a one-time HKDF child of that secret, plus a unique Ed25519 receipt. If any slot is missed, if the secret is reused on a second identity, or if a child key is repeated, the covenant is slashed and the cluster is barred for six epochs.
